usedFor: StoreHippo holds the orders, and Freshsales Classic changes a deal through “Update Deal” when “New Order” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in StoreHippo, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: An order is the clearest sign a deal is moving, so its amount and stage can follow it.

watchOut: “User Updated” fires on updates as well as new users, so the same record can run “Update Deal” twice.
